title: Severity

positions.as_written: Ask what the pain stops them doing, rather than asking for a number out of ten.
Ask about specific activities: walking distance, stairs, sleep, work, and whatever they used to do for enjoyment.
Ask what painkillers they take, how often, and whether they help, since that is a behavioural measure of severity rather than a reported one.
Ask whether it is getting worse, better or unchanged, because the trajectory matters more than the level.
